name: ask-page-extension
description: 使用 Gemini API、OpenAI API、Azure OpenAI API 或 OpenAI Compatible API 詢問關於目前頁面的問題

scripts.lint: eslint *.js --ignore-pattern lib/ && npm run lint:governance && npm run lint:anthropic && npm run lint:debug
scripts.lint:fix: eslint *.js --fix --ignore-pattern lib/ && npm run lint:governance && npm run lint:anthropic && npm run lint:debug
scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && zip -r dist/AskPageExtension.zip manifest.json background.js content.js popup.html popup.js settings.html settings.js codepen.html codepen.js i18n.js endpoint-utils.js agent-glow.js style.css icons/*.png lib _locales CHANGELOG.md README.md

author: AskPage Team
